visualCharacteristics.purpose: wrapping row of rounded pill links, e.g. an industries list

contentPattern.structure: one row per pill with a link (or one cell holding a bulleted list of links); text without a link renders as a non-linked pill

usage: Industry pill list on the French homepage (source is a filter list of industries).
reuseGuidance: Use for tag/topic/industry link clouds. The source pills were filter checkboxes; here they are links to the matching pages.
